tools.name: finance_discover
tools.description: FREE. Search the finance tool catalog by task description (e.g. 'BTC spot price', 'AAPL income statement', 'US CPI'). Returns ranked tools with id, summary, and categories. Call this first.

tools.name: finance_inspect
tools.description: FREE. Get the full contract of one tool by id (input schema, output shape, cost, rate limits). Call after finance_discover, before finance_run.

tools.name: finance_run
tools.description: Execute a finance tool by id with params. Discover, inspect, and run are free to call. Failed vendor calls return an error.
